fields.detail: tool_builder runs code/boundary/collision_census.py: (A) count all left-half reps of Fibonacci a_j for j=1..12 — the decisive refutation test of whether boundary count grows with j; (B) census boundary collisions over x<=200000, small columns k<=30, to see whether the colliding-pair set P stays exactly the known list. Lean: lean_prover states G-nonfibonacci-pairs-are-bounded plus the column-injectivity and N=2H+2 decomposition lemmas in code/lean/Lib/Boundary.lean. Verdicts: (A) does boundary count stay at 2 for j>=6 (do NOT re-run, answered here)? (B) is P exactly the known list?
fields.title: Boundary collision census + Fibonacci j=6..12 rep count
